meta.reset: Reset DB, cache and any index to `fixtures` before every case. Seed fixtures.languages. Actor rows are seeded by the harness; inject sessions directly.
meta.actor: Key into fixtures.actors, or: anonymous, garbage_session, expired_session. Actor caps are per entity: caps.languages = [create, delete]. Listing needs no capability, only a valid session.
meta.request: path_params are unescaped and must be percent-encoded when substituted. headers: null removes a default header. A request with a body carries Content-Type: application/json unless overridden. body_generator {json_padded_bytes: N, base} = valid JSON of exactly N bytes, padded with an unknown field.
meta.json_assertions: ops used: type, len_eq, includes, excludes, eq. Paths with [*] resolve to lists; filter paths like $.languages[?(@.code=='en')].name must match exactly one element.
meta.source: documented = rules inside the source_document; stated = rules you gave outside it (413, 415, 409, 401); inferred = derived from conventions or from the users tests.
meta.tags: boundary, cache, security, regression, undocumented_limit, verify_normalisation (code is lowercased/trimmed), verify_iso_list (code checked against the ISO 639-1 list, not just 2 letters), verify_name_rules (name trimming, required, length, uniqueness), verify_bodiless (Content-Type and size handling on GET/DELETE), verify_check_order (validation vs authorisation order).
meta.not_covered: Cascade deletion of translated records (needs entity routes) and concurrent creation of the same code (needs parallel steps).
